# Welcome

This is a reusable **bookdown (gitbook style)** documentation website template.

- Left sidebar navigation (collapsible)
- Search box (built-in)
- Right-hand "On this page" table of contents
- R code chunks, figures, and tables

## Quick start

```{r}
# A tiny example to confirm your setup
summary(cars)
```

## Structure

Add new pages by creating new `*.Rmd` files and listing them in `_bookdown.yml`.
